item.title: SEBASTIAN BACH Talks Dimebag Darrell’s Wild Hotel Incident: 'He Stabbed The Couch On Acid'

The former Skid Row frontman opened up in a new interview about a chaotic moment involving the late Dimebag Darrell, a knife, and a hotel lobby couch (via Sense Music Media) (transcribed by LOUDLEGENDS.
